notes.title: Dustborn is now available on macOS
notes.notes: [p]The long-awaited macOS version includes everything added to the game since launch, including numerous quality-of-life improvements, optimisations and bug fixes, and [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/721180/view/502827075746398896?l=english"]new features from our major 1.14 update[/url].[/p][p]This is (naturally) the best version of [i]Dustborn[/i] — and we’re happy to finally bring it to Mac gamers![/p][p]A single-player, story-driven road trip adventure set in an alternate history America, [i]Dustborn[/i] is a game about hope, love, friendships, personal growth, and the power of words (and also robots). Whether you’re returning to the highway or just starting your journey, this is a great time to join Pax and the crew on their cross-country adventures — particularly if you're a Mac user.[/p][p][i]Dustborn[/i] is available today for macOS 15 (Sequoia) with native support for Apple Silicon (M1/8GB RAM) and Intel (Core i5 2.7 GHz/16GB) Macs.[/p][p]Oh, and if you already purchased the Windows PC version of [i]Dustborn[/i], the Mac update is FREE.[/p]

notes.title: Free content update v1.14
notes.notes: [p]Since launch, we’ve had a ton of ideas for things we wanted to add to Dustborn. And since the release of v1.8 last autumn, we’ve been bringing those ideas to life, piece by piece — improving the game in meaningful ways, with help from our players.[/p][p]We’ve even made [url="https://trello.com/b/zpS441E2/dustborn-roadmap"]our roadmap public[/url], giving the community an opportunity to suggest and vote on the features, fixes, and additions you care the most about. The feedback has been both generous and helpful.[/p][p]Today, we’re excited to announce our biggest and most ambitious update yet: version 1.14 — available now![/p][p]This update touches nearly every aspect of the game. Combat is punchier and more varied, with new hit effects, enemy types, and weapons — plus tweaks to timing, flow, and impact. Life on the bus is more dynamic, reflecting the choices you’ve made throughout the game. You’ll get deeper insight into each crew member’s Coda, and on your second play-through, you’ll finally get a glimpse into Pax’s previously hidden Coda[b] [/b]changes. We’ve also added brand-new narrative content — including a fresh cut-scene in Maine — and made a ton of polish and bug fixes.[/p][p]There's a [i]lot[/i].[/p][p]For a look at what’s new in this update — and a recap of [i]some[/i] of the most important things we’ve added since launch — check out our quick video summary:[/p][previewyoutube="-FFWF-0zHnY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Dustborn has always been a passion project for our tiny team, and it means the world to us to see more people connecting with it. We’ll continue to listen, build, and share — with even more updates planned for the second half of 2025. So stay tuned![/p][p]And as always: thank you so much for playing! We appreciate you.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Change log — version 1.14[/h2][p][/p][h3]Combat overhaul[/h3][list][*][p]New Justice enemy types, weapons, attacks, and combat challenges[/p][/*][*][p]Hits now spawn comic-style words like [i]Wham![/i], [i]Bam![/i], [i]Thump![/i][/p][/*][*][p]A whole bunch of tweaks to improve the feel and flow of fights[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bus life improvements[/h3][list][*][p]The crew will now use the gifts you give them[/p][/*][*][p]The bulletin board tracks memories and mementos[/p][/*][*][p]Collected gifts appear on the bus[/p][/*][*][p]Improved dishwashing mechanics (seriously!)[/p][/*][/list][h3]CODA upgrades[/h3][list][*][p]Added Coda text to the post-credits scene[/p][/*][*][p]You can now compare your end-game Coda stats with other players[/p][/*][*][p]Option to disable Coda pop-ups (community request)[/p][/*][*][p]On subsequent play-throughs, Pax’s hidden Codas can be toggled to visible[/p][/*][/list][h3]Content updates[/h3][list][*][p] New cut-scene in Maine[/p][/*][*][p] Dynamic title screen that evolves with your crew[/p][/*][/list][h3]A LOT of bug fixes[/h3][list][*][p] 78(!) bugs squashed — thanks to community reports on Steam and [url="https://www.redthreadgames.com/discord"]Discord[/url][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Dustborn update v1.12: March 2025
notes.notes:
[h1]Dustborn Marches ever onwards (sorry)[/h1]

[i](Yes: we know it's April, the patch notes are coming in very late! No: this isn't an April Fool's post.) [/i]

Our latest content update is a relatively minor one, but addresses something we’ve wanted to do for a long time: more Herald, more context to the Puritans storyline. We’re not done with this yet — we have some additional plans for the game’s ending — but the new Pax-meets-the-Herald scenes in issues #4, #7 and #10 add important details and context to a part of the story we weren’t completely happy with.

Aside from that, there’s now an alternate way to enter the New Jerusalem mall, using Ziggy; the first of hopefully many radio broadcasts; and a couple of important bug fixes and optimisations.

We hope you enjoy this (minor) update! We have something really special planned for our next big content update, scheduled for “spring 2025”. (Norwegian spring, that is. Our summer doesn’t really begin until June.)

[h2]Change log — version 1.12[/h2]

[h3]Content updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New and updated Herald scenes in issues #4, #7, and #10.
[*] The first of several planned radio broadcasts added to the bus after leaving Liberty (issue #2).
[*] Alternate path to entering the New Jerusalem mall, using Ziggy. This path is Coda-dependent.[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed checkpoint saving for key moments.
[*] Resolved ME-EM “jiggle” issues on low frame-rates.
[*] Addressed several memory-related crashes.[/list]

notes.title: GLAAD Media Awards Nomination for Outstanding Video Game
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38037903/dbe40fb6a4891514185a5a0ec68ab64c72a23601.jpg[/img]

[i]"Dustborn is perhaps 2024’s most misunderstood game. Upon its release in August, an unfortunate barrage of online criticisms quickly usurped any opportunity for meaningful discourse about it. But having actually played the game, we wholeheartedly believe that its twisting story and vibrant world are worth experiencing."[/i]

This description from GLAAD, featured in their list of standout titles from 2024, is an affirmation of what the development team set out to achieve. [i]Dustborn[/i] is a heartfelt story about inclusion and diversity in a world that often feels hostile to those ideals.

"Being nominated for a GLAAD Media Award means so much to me, both as a creator and as a gay man," writes Christoffer Grav, Senior Art Director at Red Thread Games. "With Dustborn, we set out to celebrate diversity and give a voice to those who often feel unseen. This recognition is a reminder of why representation in media matters and inspires me to keep telling stories that make a difference."

We are incredibly honoured and grateful for the nomination, and proud to be in such inspiring company.

You can read about the other nominees here:

https://glaad.org/glaad-celebrates-outstanding-video-game-nominees-at-the-36th-annual-glaad-media-awards-glaadawards/

notes.title: Brand NEW Dustborn demo!
notes.notes:
We've released a new demo!

But wait…WHY a new demo when the game's been out for FIVE (!) months?

We removed the old demo before Christmas. It was [i]very[/i] outdated; developed for Steam's Next Fest in June 2024, it included none of the important and game-changing updates and upgrades from the past seven (!!) months.

The old demo also didn't, uh, [i]demonstrate[/i] what Dustborn is all about. It was too disjointed and fragmented, which made it hard to understand the story and characters. It dropped you into combat without a proper tutorial, and you didn't get enough time to hang with the crew — a big part of the Dustborn experience. This is, after all, a game about people and relationships…and only occasionally and tangentially about fighting zombie robots. (There's [i]some[/i] of that, sure. But there's a lot more branching dialogue and emotional choices.)

The new demo is very much [i]THE GAME[/i]. If you enjoy this, you'll probably enjoy the rest of it.

(Conversely, and importantly, if you DON'T like the demo…well, Dustborn isn't for you. You don't have to buy it and return it and we can all go our separate ways, no hard feelings. It's one of them win-win scenarios!)

So what does this new demo do differently?

It contains the FULL first two chapters (we call them "issues", like in comic-books) and your progress carries over to the purchased game. Depending on your pace and patience, that's potentially two hours of FREE playtime — more than enough to decide if you vibe with it (or not).

One caveat: we update the game on a regular basis, and the demo will most likely [i]not[/i] get those updates, so over time the two will diverge — but that shouldn't affect the experience TOO much. Most of the patches and content updates focus on later chapters (sorry, [i]issues[/i]) and gameplay features like the combat system.

On that note: we do have some cool updates in store for this year, so keep an eye out for that, if you're interested!

If you haven't played Dustborn yet, here's your chance to do so for REAL, no strings attached! (It certainly beats watching those [i]carefully edited[/i] YouTube videos.) If you played the old demo and didn't like it, maybe give this one a shot to see if you feel differently?

And if you already own the game… THANK YOU! There's nothing here for you. [i]Nothing[/i]. Sorry.

notes.title: Dustborn update v1.10: The 2024 Holiday Special
notes.notes:
[h1]Dustborn, the holiday edition[/h1]

Just in time for the holidays, [b]version 1.10 [/b] — our [i]second[/i] major update since launch — brings performance improvements, bug fixes, and new content to [b]Dustborn[/b].

As always, we welcome and appreciate your feedback, suggestions, and bug reports — both in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/721180/discussions/0/]Steam discussion forum[/url] and [url=discord.gg/dustborn]on Discord[/url].

We hope you enjoy our latest update…and this is still [i]just[/i] the beginning! We have more [i]exciting and surprising[/i] game updates planned for next year — including features and content [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/721180/discussions/0/596260925367951826/]suggested by our community[/url].

[i]Players on other platforms: this version will be available through alternative PC storefronts (Epic/GOG) and on consoles next week.[/i]

Merry Christmas, Happy New Year, thanks for playing [b]Dustborn[/b], and we'll see you all in 2025!

[h2]Change log — version 1.10[/h2]

[h3]Performance and bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimisations and improved performance in multiple scenes, including La Torre in issue #1 and Betty's Diner in issue #10.
[*] Occlusion/LOD fixes in several locations (including the first dream sequence) to improve performance and reduce popping.
[*] Full-screen overlays (e.g. character introduction screens) previously hid subtitles; this has now been fixed.
[*] Some inventory item textures were blurry when the visual quality was set to low or medium. Those textures are now higher resolution.
[*] The crew should now (finally!) respond correctly to Pax's choice of t-shirt at the first campfire.
[*] Smaller bug fixes throughout the game, including dialogue branching corrections and dialogue audio volume improvements.
[*] Save game feature update.
[/list]
[h3]Features and enhancements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Additional polish and bug fixes in issues #0-1. The opening hours have received special attention, to improve the quality and pacing of the new player experience. This includes dialogue edits and new animations, staging changes, timing tweaks and fresh content.
[*] New scenes and dialogue lines added throughout the game to better explain the Puritans and Axiom storyline. More to come in future updates!
[*] Improved ultra-widescreen support.
[*] Enhancements to the combat tutorial at the end of issue #1, including new cameras and animations, dialogue tweaks, and a more polished post-combat scene.
[*] Band game: UI tweaks and new comic-book panels during band performances.
[*] New bat-throwing taunt finisher. This finisher is used primarily on airborne enemies.
[*] Prologue comic is now accessible immediately upon unlock. The option to read the prologue is also highlighted on the title screen until the comic-book is accessed.
[*] Camera auto-follow functionality. Available in settings, under "Controls".
[*] New graphics modes: Fidelity, Balanced, and Performance. Available in settings, under "Video".
[/list]

notes.title: Dustborn content update v1.8
notes.notes:
[h1]November 2024 content update[/h1]

[h2]Content additions, QoL improvements, and bug fixes[/h2]

We’re excited to bring you our latest update, featuring new content, quality of life improvements, and a bunch of bug fixes to make your cross-country road trip aboard the Cougar Cruiser a smoother and more enjoyable ride!

Here are the highlights:

[h3]Dialogue line skipping[/h3]

By popular request, you can now skip dialogue lines with the spacebar (game controllers: Ⓑ/Ⓞ).

[h3]Introducing “Coda Moments”[/h3]

Ever wonder when your choices impact the story? “Coda Moments” highlight key branching moments linked to your crew's Codas.

[h3]Combat skipping and difficulty tweaks[/h3]

The new Story Mode skips all combat encounters automatically — for players who just want the story. You can also skip individual fights in Easy and Normal modes.

Hard Mode has upped the stakes: you can die, which sends you back to the last checkpoint.

[h3]Enhanced combat mechanics[/h3]

We heard your feedback and we've made some changes to combat:

Pax's bat now reacts to walls and obstacles, dealing incidental damage on its way to enemies. Plus, there's a new bat-throw animation and a cooldown for more strategic throws.

We've improved blocking: hold the block button for continuous defence with an increased auto-turn radius.

We've also added three new chain combos to Pax's arsenal of melee bat-attacks.

[h3]Save-game browser[/h3]

You can now browse and restore older saves, offering more control over your progress.

[h3]Additional gameplay enhancements[/h3]

Manually exit band rehearsals, find alternate paths through challenges, discover extra lore and environmental details, like movie posters and new arcade machines in the mall.

[h3]Comic-book updates[/h3]

We’ve polished the wrap-up comics and Coda pages, and added Coda pages for Theo.

(There’s also a new post-credits scene: restore the last checkpoint and rewatch the credits to see it!)

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]

Fixed camera control issues, resolved scene-blocking bugs, and squashed memory leaks.
Additional fixes for specific scenes and combat mechanics have been addressed.

Thanks for your feedback! We'll continue to make improvements, changes and additions based on your comments and input, so please let us know what you think!

[h2]Full patch notes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Dialogue line skipping

[list]
[*] Use spacebar to skip dialogue lines, when possible
[*] Not all dialogue lines can be skipped. This is due to scripts and animations that run in the background.
[*] On Xbox controllers this action is mapped to the Ⓑ button.
[*] On PlayStation controllers this action is mapped to the Ⓞ button.
[/list]
[*] CODA Moments

[list]
[*] “Coda Moment” pop-ups have been added throughout the game.
[*] Coda Moments highlight when the story branches or events happen because of a character’s current Coda.
[/list]
[*] Skip combat functionality

[list]
[*] For players who want to focus on the story, there’s a new “story mode” that automatically skips all combat encounters.
[*] Combat difficulty modes renamed to “Easy”, “Normal”, and “Hard”.
[*] In addition, a “Skip combat” button is displayed when playing in easy/normal modes, enabling players to skip single fights.
[/list]
[*] “Hard” combat mode made harder

[list]
[*] You can now die when playing on the hard difficulty setting.
[*] Dying puts you back at the previous checkpoint.
[/list]
[*] Versus and victory screens added to all combat scenes

[*] Bat updates

[list]
[*] Pax’s magnetic bat no longer passes through environmental collision. Instead, if the bat hits a wall or obstacle, it bounces back.
[*] The bat does incidental damage if it hits enemies on its way to the target.
[*] Pax’s bat-throwing animation has been replaced with a better animation.
[*] The bat has a cooldown before Pax can throw it again.
[/list]
[*] Improved combat blocking

[list]
[*] Based on player feedback, we’ve improved the block functionality.
[*] You can now hold the block-button to keep blocking, and Pax’s auto-turn radius has been increased.
[*] Blocking is interrupted by attacking.
[/list]
[*] New chain attacks

[list]
[*] Three new chain attacks added to combat.
[/list]
[*] Timing pass on banter dialogue

[list]
[*] Combat banter dialogue is now paced better, with more pauses in banter, less overlapping dialogue.
[*] Combat banter can still be switched off in accessibility settings.
[/list]
[*] Save-game browser

[list]
[*] You can now browse and restore older save games, not just the previous checkpoint.
[/list]
[*] Exit band rehearsal

[list]
[*] Added functionality for manually exiting band rehearsal scenes.
[/list]
[*] Band mini-game calibration

[list]
[*] Calibration has been added to the first songwriting scene.
[*] Calibration is still available from the game settings screen.
[/list]
[*] Pax's initial reaction to Robot

[list]
[*] Players are no longer forced to use Vox on the robot driver in La Torre.
[*] Pax will not use Vox if you simply let the dialogue time out.
[/list]
[*] Alternate path for getting into The Bad Lands Bar & Grill in Chicago

[list]
[*] There’s now an alternate way to get into the bar, which affects branching and the comic book.
[/list]
[*] New post-credits scene

[list]
[*] There’s a brand new post-credits stinger.
[*] Tip to players who have completed the game: restore the last checkpoint and watch the credits!
[/list]
[*] Noam may sing happy birthday to Mr President in the mall

[list]
[*] This only happens if Noam’s current Coda is ████████.
[/list]
[*] Noam plays hide-and-seek

[list]
[*] Noam will now participate in the hide-and-seek segment in the farmhouse if their current Coda is ████████.
[/list]
[*] Visual updates to the wrap-up comic book pages

[list]
[*] Many pages have been polished and improved.
[/list]
[*] Visual updates to the Coda splash pages at the end of the game

[list]
[*] Several of the Coda endings have been polished and improved.
[/list]
[*] Added Coda pages for Theo

[list]
[*] Theo now gets a post-game Coda.
[/list]
[*] Added missing Pax reflection moment in Camp Cedar

[*] Movie posters added to the mall cinema

[*] New arcade machines (non-playable) added to the mall arcade

[*] Added more JFK lore to the opening scenes of the game

[*] Added animated icon to the “feat of strength” tapping mini-game (e.g. Pax lifting bus in La Torre)

[*] Fixed inertia-issues when using mouse to control camera

[*] There’s now a setting to turn on/off camera smoothing.

[*] Fixed a problem where the heli-carrier cutscene in issue #10 broke the taunt camera

[*] Fixed blocker when using Sai interaction on bus in La Torre immediately after trying to lift bus

[*] Fixed bug with saving and reloading during motel escape

[*] Fixed bug in a campfire scene where gifting Theo something teleported Pax to another spot in the scene

[*] Fixed bugs in combat movement set

[*] Fixed multiple memory leaks
[/list]

notes.title: Dustborn is the latest addition to the nascent misfits-on-a-road-trip genre
notes.notes:
The misfits-on-a-road-trip genre arguably began bloody ages ago, it's true, but I think it's really been building momentum over the last few years with stuff like Signs Of The Sojourner, Hitchhiker, and even Road 96. Red Thread Games, who made Draugen (a horror game I liked quite a bit), are adding to the list with Dustborn, a single-player action-adventure with a heavy lean towards story, which was revealed at this year's Gamescom Opening Night Live.

You play Pax, a pregnant con-artist on the run transporting an important package across the Northern border of what appears to be an authoritarian, dystopian USA. And you tell me this is in no way related to Road 96? Well, alright. Dustborn is being published by Quantic Dream, so I feel dutybound to make fun of it. No. Must... resist...

notes.title: Dustborn is about smashing cops with words, bats
notes.notes:
Red Thread Games, the studio behind Dreamfall Chapters and Draugen, have announced a new action adventure game, Dustborn, with a shiny trailer.

It’s a road trip game about a sooorta queer-coded group of misfits driving a mysterious cargo across America, chased by “fanatical Puritans” and blocked by “the authoritarian Justice”. Also you’re a folk-punk band, and must practice around the campfire for a showdown at Battle of the Bands. No, really.
